description.en: The list of effective authentication source IDs.

description.zh:
密码过期动作。当PasswordExpirationStatus取值为enabled时必传，取值可选范围：
- forbid\_login：禁止登录。
- force\_update\_password：强制修改密码。
- remind\_update\_password：提醒修改密码。
description.en:
The action to take when a password expires. This parameter is required when PasswordExpirationStatus is set to enabled. Valid values:
- forbid\_login: Prohibit logon.
- force\_update\_password: Force password change.
- remind\_update\_password: Remind to change password.

description.zh: 密码过期通知渠道列表，当PasswordExpirationNotificationStatus取值为enabled时必传。
description.en: The list of password expiration notification channels. This parameter is required when PasswordExpirationNotificationStatus is set to enabled.

description.zh: 密码过期通知时间，单位是天。当PasswordExpirationNotificationStatus取值为enabled时必传。
description.en: The password expiration notification time, in days. This parameter is required when PasswordExpirationNotificationStatus is set to enabled.

description.zh:
密码过期通知状态，取值可选范围：
- enabled：开启。
- disabled：禁用。
description.en:
The password expiration notification status. Valid values:
- enabled: Enabled.
- disabled: Disabled.

description.zh:
密码过期配置状态，取值可选范围：
- enabled：开启。
- disabled：禁用。
description.en:
The password expiration configuration status. Valid values:
- enabled: Enabled.
- disabled: Disabled.

description.zh: 密码强制修改时间，单位是天。当前字段取值要比PasswordExpirationNotificationDuration大。
description.en: The forced password change time, in days. The value of this parameter must be greater than the value of PasswordExpirationNotificationDuration.

description.zh: 密码有效时长，单位是天。当PasswordExpirationStatus取值为enabled时必传。
description.en: The validity period of a password, in days. This parameter is required when PasswordExpirationStatus is set to enabled.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eiam set-password-expiration-configuration --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --password-expiration-status enabled --password-valid-max-day 180 --password-expiration-action force_update_password --password-expiration-notification-status enabled --password-expiration-notification-channels login --password-expiration-notification-duration 7 --password-forced-update-duration 7 --effective-authentication-source-ids ia_passwordxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eiam SetPasswordExpirationConfiguration --region cn-hangzhou --PasswordExpirationStatus enabled --PasswordExpirationNotificationChannels.1 login --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --PasswordForcedUpdateDuration 7 --EffectiveAuthenticationSourceIds.1 ia_passwordxxxx --PasswordValidMaxDay 180 --PasswordExpirationNotificationDuration 7 --PasswordExpirationAction force_update_password --PasswordExpirationNotificationStatus enabled --method POST --force
